description: This file contains the CSS styles for managing the theme and layout of the React-based tic-tac-toe web application, including styles for light and dark themes, layout, and responsive design.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class that centers its content and applies theme-based background and text colors.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header class for styling the main header area of the application.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Class for styling links within the application.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Class for the button that toggles between light and dark themes.
